PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.

7. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.

8. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

9. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.

10. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

11. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.

12. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Production Unit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Immediate Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
